title: Concept Record (Semantic Vocabulary Foundation, minimal C-1)
description: Minimal Concept Record schema materialized per DC_20260715_008 (C-1 adoption conditions) and design spec SEMANTIC_VOCABULARY_CONCEPT_RECORD_SCHEMA_DESIGN_v0.1. This file is a type definition only (no data). No relation field (adoption condition 6). Some invariants (exactly-one-active for definition and naming_history, and canonical_name equals the active naming entry) are documented here but are NOT enforced by this schema; their enforcement is the responsibility of a future Validator (Option A, deferred). This materialization does not include storage, API, MCP, or a validator.

concept_id.description: Immutable unique identifier in the form CN_YYYYMMDD_NNN (adoption condition 1). Not changed after creation.

canonical_name.description: Current active name. Points to the active naming_history entry (invariant enforced by future Validator).

concept_layer.description: Meaning layer (Principle 2). Set changes are Human Gate (Principle 1).

status.description: Lifecycle status. Allowed transitions are defined in the design spec; transition enforcement is the future Validator.

schema_version.description: SemVer of the semantic vocabulary schema (adoption condition 2; initial value 1.0.0). Changes are Human Gate (Principle 1).

provenance.description: Evidence Origin (adoption condition 3). At least one reference required.

definition.description: Append-only definition history (Principle 3). Exactly one entry has status=active (adoption condition 4). The exactly-one-active invariant is not expressible in vanilla JSON Schema and is enforced by the future Validator.

naming_history.description: Embedded append-only naming history (adoption condition 5). Exactly one entry has status=active and equals canonical_name; enforced by the future Validator.
